Section 1-104 amended a section of EO 12036 (United States Intelligence Activities) by inserting a sentence requiring electronic surveillance to be conducted in accordance with the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act. It is a one-time amending command that took effect when EO 12139 issued on 1979-05-23 (the order states no separate effective date); once the sentence was inserted the command had nothing further to execute, so it is exhausted by performance on that date. The inserted text then operated only as part of EO 12036; the held Federal Register text of EO 12333 (signed 1981-12-04) section 3.6 revokes EO 12036 (its page check is not completed, so it is not cited as a source), which ends the surviving consequence of the insertion but does not change the date the command was performed. The current U.S. Code note records that sections 1-104 and 1-105 amended EO 12036 and no longer prints their text.

research_rationale:
EO 12139 (44 FR 30311, signed 1979-05-23; FR Doc. 79-16621) authorizes the Attorney General to approve warrantless electronic surveillance for foreign intelligence under section 102(a)(1) of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (section 1-101), to approve applications to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court under section 102(b) (section 1-102), designates seven named senior officials to make the certifications required by section 104(a)(7) of that Act and limits the authority to officials appointed with Senate consent (section 1-103 and its subsections), and amends sections 2-202 and 2-203 of EO 12036 (sections 1-104 and 1-105). Identity: the held Federal Register text of 44 FR 30311 (PDF page 11) prints 'Executive Order 12139 of May 23, 1979' and 'Foreign Intelligence Electronic Surveillance'. The twelve machine clauses are the complete inventory; subsections (a) and (b) are merged for quotation checking. Later events: EO 13383 (signed 2005-07-15) amends section 1-103 by replacing the Director of Central Intelligence with the Director of National Intelligence in (c), replacing the Deputy Director of Central Intelligence with the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency in (g) and adding a subsection (h); EO 13475 (signed 2008-10-07) amends section 1-103 by replacing (7) with (6) where it appears (the lead), adding a subsection (i) and adding a sentence to the closing paragraph. Neither revokes any part. Context: EO 12333 section 3.6 (signed 1981-12-04) revokes EO 12036, which sections 1-104 and 1-105 amended; it acts on EO 12036, not on EO 12139, and its page check is not completed in the packet, so it is disclosed here and not cited as a source. Result at 2026-10-14: sections 1-101, 1-102 and 1-103 with its subsections continue as amended, as the current U.S. Code note prints them; sections 1-104 and 1-105 were exhausted by performance on 1979-05-23.
